q: After the 2026 amendment, how many judges can the Supreme Court have besides the CJI?
x: 37 + CJI = 38 in all (earlier 33 + CJI). Parliament fixes the number by law under Article 124(1).

q: Which state's name was changed in the Constitution in August 2026?
x: Kerala became Keralam by a law under Articles 3–4, not by an amendment under Article 368. Orissa became Odisha in 2011.

q: Who became Chief Minister of West Bengal in May 2026?
x: Suvendu Adhikari formed the first BJP government in West Bengal.

q: V.D. Satheesan became Chief Minister of which state in 2026?
x: Kerala; the Congress-led UDF government was sworn in on 18 May 2026.

q: Who is the present Chief Justice of India?
x: Justice Surya Kant, the 53rd CJI, serves till 9 February 2027.
